|quest_reward3_quest = Fallen from Grace |quest_reward3_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward3_act = 6 |quest_reward3_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Flicker Strike''' is a [[melee]] [[attack]] skill that teleports the character to a nearby enemy and strikes it with their weapon and grants increased movement speed for a short time. If no specific monster is chosen, one is picked at random. The skill has a cooldown that can be bypassed by expending a [[Frenzy Charge]] and has a chance to generate a Frenzy Charge when used. ==Skill Functions and Interactions== Because teleportation is instant movement, the attacker is considered to be [[stationary]] at every point in time, but is also considered to move each time they teleport. This means the attacker benefits from effects such as the [[Inexorable]] notable passive skill while attacking, but never from {{c|mod|while moving}} modifiers. Teleporting also continually resets the timer for {{c|mod|per second you've been stationary}} effects.https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/1952961 Minimum [[Frenzy Charges]] cannot be consumed to bypass the cooldown. [[Dual Wielding]] while using Flicker Strike will cause the player to alternate weapons each strike. Flicker Strike can target an enemy within a [[distance]] of 4 meters by default. This is unaffected by modifiers to [[area of effect]]. Modifiers to Melee Strike [[Range#Attack Range and Area of Effect Radius|Range]] have no special interaction with teleports: the attacker will neither "land" farther from the target when flickering, nor will they be able to initiate an attack from farther away. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression }} {{Item acquisition}} {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} {{Alternate skill effect list}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * Now has a Mana cost of 5 at gem level 1, scaling up to 8 at gem level 20 (previously 10 at all gem levels). * Now has 177% Effectiveness of Base and Added Damage at gem level 1 (previously 142%), scaling up to 408% at gem level 20 (previously 210%). }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Quality now provides 0-10% chance to gain a Frenzy Charge on Hit (previously 0-5%). }} {{Version history table row|3.15.0| * Now deals 210% of Base Damage, and has 210% Effectiveness of Added Damage at gem level 20 (previously 168%). }} {{Version history table row|3.7.0| * Now deals base damage equal to, and has an added damage effectiveness of, 142%-168% (from 130%-160%) * Now grants 15% chance to gain a [[Frenzy charge]] on hit at all levels. * Now grants a buff that provides +20% increased movement speed for 3 seconds. * Now has a 120% attack speed multiplier, instead of 20% more attack speed.
